summary: Master implementation plan for FREIGHTFLOW 360, a production-grade multi-tenant international logistics SaaS ecosystem covering end-to-end shipment lifecycles, Gemini AI document processing & mismatch auditing, role-specific portals (Freight Forwarder, Exporter, Importer, Customs Broker, Transporter, Overseas Agent, Super Admin), container demurrage management, financial accounting, marketplace, and Razorpay subscription billing.
